reason: A spec-driven development skill bundle that guides projects from idea clarification through specification, ordered implementation, and acceptance validation using reviewable files under specs/.

summaries.zh: 一个以规格为单一事实来源的开发工作流插件，帮助用户从需求澄清和规格编写推进到按任务实现与验收验证。
summaries.en: A spec-driven development workflow plugin that guides users from clarifying requirements and writing specifications through ordered implementation and acceptance validation.

capabilities: asks clarifying questions and creates requirements, design, and task specification files under specs/
creates runnable checks from acceptance criteria
writes implementation progress and validation reports back to specs/
